There's no function for roster. So we need to respond with a list. We might not have up-to-date data. We could provide a general answer or say we don't have current roster. But maybe we can approximate. However, we should not hallucinate. We can say we don't have real-time data. Alternatively, we can provide a known roster from last season. But it's better to be cautious.
